full_details: You did not name the place the straight road is for. At Uxbridge you kept a mile out of the way. Sixteen days at twelvepence stood, inside the journey. On the stair the chamber was aired, Heminges's note said Friday at nine, and the hired bag was to go tonight. Gib was on the Holinshed. You unpacked Anne's list before your own notes and did not read it aloud. The ledger took four lines. You were asleep by eight.
one_sentence: You came in by the long way, gave the bay back at three, and counted the coffer at nineteen pounds six shillings before you slept.
title: Sixteen days, and the coffer counted
